comment: Per-chunk gzip-size ceilings in bytes, checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs after `vite build`. A chunk fails the gate when it exceeds its budget by more than slopPercent. Chunk keys are name prefixes ("index" matches index-AbC123.js). Initial ceilings were set ~5% above the first measured build with CodeMirror + Milkdown in place; re-pin deliberately when a feature grows a chunk, so the diff in this file is what reviewers see. Chunks without an entry are reported but never fail. Export (PR after #4): index re-pinned 10.5 -> 11.7 KB for the export dialog and commands; the lazy export chunks (docx, markdownPdf = pdf-lib + renderer, marked) get their own ceilings so a dependency bump that bloats them is caught even though they never load at start-up. Re-pinned index 11.7 -> 14.4 KB (measured 13.4 KB) for three deliberate eager additions since: the IndexedDB file-handle store (recent files reopen the real file), the keep-source-style block merge, and the incremental visual sync. All three run on the editing path, so lazy-loading them would delay the first edit. Re-pinned index 14.4 -> 17.4 KB (measured 16.2 KB) for image paste/drop: the paste/drop handlers and image node view must be present before the first paste, plus the image-title parse fix and new UI strings. The image service itself, the find bar, outline and format toolbar are lazy chunks. Re-pinned index 17.4 -> 19.5 KB (measured 18.2 KB) for tabs and locale support: the tab model, multi-document persistence and the tab bar are on the start-up path (a restored session opens in its tabs). The tab bar is deliberately not lazy: lazy-loading it made Rolldown move ~2.8 KB of shared app code (i18n catalogue, store) into a chunk named after react, which hid it from this budget instead of saving anything.
